summary: Intake readiness is blocked. The Registration intake exists at `.ai_factory/delivery/intakes/13612888-96ef-4fa4-a304-4a400d9f2e24.md`, and the project brief confirms Next.js, TypeScript, and Playwright. However, the requested Google/GitHub registration requires missing prerequisites and decisions: OAuth provider app credentials/callback configuration, auth/session strategy, and where registered customer identities will be persisted. Evidence: `rg -n "next-auth|authjs|OAuth|Google|GitHub|Github|register|registration|auth" .ai_factory src package.json` found only the intake and a landing-page note saying authentication is future work; `package.json` has no auth dependency; environment inspection found no Google/GitHub OAuth client IDs/secrets or auth secret. No tests were run for this readiness review.

defects.description: Google and GitHub registration cannot be implemented or validated end to end until OAuth application credentials, callback URLs, and required auth secrets are provided or an explicit mock-only/test strategy is approved.

The intake does not define the account model, session strategy, or persistence target for registered customers, and the current project has no authentication or storage architecture documented under `.ai_factory/docs/`.
